text:
Alex H: Trying to enable scale-to-zero for the gpu-worker pool (mixed instance types + preemptible spots). Cluster Autoscaler keeps flapping: it launches a spot node, then drains and scales it down, pods get evicted and rescheduled in another region. Anyone seen this with --balance-similar-node-groups + mixed spot types?

Rina S: Which CA flags are you running? Also are any pods using hostNetwork or local storage?

Alex H: Current flags we tested:
```
--expander=least-waste
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5
--max-empty-bulk-delete=1
```
Pods: most are fine, but a few GPU jobs have PVCs (RWX) and our GPU daemonset uses hostNetwork.

Jamal: Two main angles: 1) spots get preempted -> CA sees capacity changes and may mark nodes unneeded; 2) balance-similar-node-groups + mixed types can cause CA to shuffle scaling between groups which looks like flapping if thresholds are low.

Cory: Also check `--scale-down-delay-after-add`. Default is tiny and causes CA to consider a node for removal too soon after creation. Try `--scale-down-delay-after-add=20m`. Increase `--scale-down-unneeded-time` too.

Rina S: And verify kubelet eviction and node-problem-detector TTLs. If spots are cordoned by system daemons right after start CA might double-handle them.

Alex H: Tried updated config:
```
--expander=least-waste
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
--scale-down-delay-after-add=15m
--scale-down-unneeded-time=20m
--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=true
```
Still saw CA remove a node at ~12m and GPU pods got killed/failed with OOM on restart.

Maya: Could be the GPU device plugin terminating pods on preemption. Also consider tainting the GPU pool `gpu=true:NoSchedule` and only allow GPU workloads with tolerations so regular pods don't land there (reduces churn).

infra-bot: Notice: cluster-autoscaler v1.24.* has a known bug with `--balance-similar-node-groups` on mixed-instance groups that can trigger premature scale-down. Upgrade to v1.25.3+ recommended.

Jamal: +1 to upgrade CA. Also for critical GPU jobs annotate with `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict=false` so CA won't evict them during scale-down decisions.

Alex H: Thanks — planning upgrade + taints + higher scale-down timers. One practical question: cost tradeoff — keep 1 warm GPU per region vs scale-from-zero? We see ~90s cold starts which is borderline.

Cory: If 90s is acceptable in your SLO, scale-to-zero is cheaper. If you need <30s p95, keep 1 warm node per region. Warm node cost is baseline + spot/reserved discounts; often cheaper to reserve 1 and autoscale the rest.

Alex H: Will run the CA upgrade and try the new flags. Will post CA logs (`--v=4`) if it still flaps. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Rina S: If you can capture the CA decision log lines around the deletions we can trace which predicate triggered removal.

Alex H: Will do and share.
